description: This file declares the IpcFactory class which implements the IIpcFactory interface. It provides factory methods to create application management and session management server instances within the Rialto media server IPC component.

classes.name: IpcFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating IPC server instances related to application and session management within the Rialto media server.

methods.name: createApplicationManagementServer
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to an application management server, given a session server manager.

methods.name: createSessionManagementServer
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to a session management server, given playback, Cdm, and control services.
